review_description: Over all very good everything explainedVery good to deal with would recommend

From start to completion Solargain Gippsland were amazing.  Ben gave us lots of time during the initial engagement and development phase to ensure we understood the system, what was being proposed and how it would work.  All our queries were answered and Ben always responded in a timely manner and displayed the utmost professionalism from start to finish.  On site Riley and his team were polite, professional and helpful in explaining what they had installed. The independent electrical safety inspector/auditor when he visited commented on how neat and tidy the installation was done to the applicable Australian Standards.
Thanks guys for such a professional job. The pride in the workmanship can be seen in your completed work. Thanks again .Trevor and Linda

We took our time to review the received quotes and settled on Solargain as we felt their solution was one of good quality and met our needs. The install happened fairly quick following them given the go ahead and the installers were very proficient with the job completed in approx 7hrs. The final inspection took approx 1 week before we were live and another week for our meter to be re-configured. The app tells us we are using the grid between 50 to 60% less than pre-solar so are very interested in seeing our next bill!

Solargain were very prompt with quotethe installation crew were on time, very professional, polite and friendly - did an excellent job and left the site very tidy and cleanThe post installation instructions were concise and easy to follow
Very helpful, especially for grant and loan applicationsNeat job, Polite,Tidy, PunctualThey organised everything for the connection and gave me full instructions for all of the system.

- Solar gain were the last to provide us with a quote (we had about 7 or 8 installers provide quotes). I feel that they were the only ones who really listened to what we wanted to get out of our new system and designed it accordingly. They inspected the property, gave an overview of a number of different options, demoed their apps and gave pros and cons of each. They responded to every question I had on the day, and were always happy to answer the phone when I had further queries. We had conflicting advice from a number of installers and Solargain were only 1 of 2 that I truly trusted and had confidence in.The install went really well. They were punctual and worked non stop. The system was installed very quickly. Very polite and friendly. Cleaned up after themselves and double and triple checked everything.Customer service was great the whole way through. Very responsive and always happy to talk through questions/concerns. We had a very minor issue with some minor cosmetic damage to the battery cover/faceplate and Solargain were very quick to accept responsibility and rectify the issue. They take pride in their work and we're keen to ensure the problem was resolved.After install they ran me through how to setup and use the Tesla app.

Solargain responded promptly to a request for a quote. Quotes were received from two other suppliers but Solargain was the only one to visit our site which I felt was important to gain a proper understanding of requirements.Installation occurred sooner than I had expected and the team worked hard for a day and a half. Work was neatly finished, all waste removed and the installers were all friendly and efficient. Explanation of the operation of the equipment was adequate and electrical inspection occurred soon after.One other factor that helped in choosing Solargain for our installation was that they were able to provide non-Tesla products (we did not want to support Elon Musk due to his recent behaviours).

Solargain visited our home, carried out a thorough inspection of our electrical fuse box to ensure that it had the capacity rating to handle the Solar panel and battery system. They also inspected the roof to ensure that the panels could be fastened to it and the garage area to house the inverter and battery systems.  Once that was complete Solargain explained to us what was feasible and they listened to our requirements and needs. They then suggested the system and what it may cost. They told us about the State and Federal Government rebate schemes.  A firm quotation and then installation followed.The quotation procedure was professional, the agent listened , was not overbearing and  was very polite.Solargain organised all the connection details.     The installation process was also professional and on time, The install team were knowledgeable, explained fully what and why they were carrying out their tasks at the Switch board, Inverter Battery and Solar Panels Installs.  The team  had great inter personal skills, were well trained and well led on site.

SolarGain were always prompt with any enquiries I made and in fact were the only installer who gave me any meaningful answers about my system design.They helped with the government rebates and system design.On the day 6 tradies in a van turned up and got to work. 7 hours and the system was done ready to be turned on. It was a hot day, 35°C and even hotter on the roof I bet.My install was non-standard, but after the site visit they stood by the original quote.It’s all tested, certified and running perfectly.

Cannot recommend Solar Gain Gippsland highly enough - from the quoting process to the appointment booking to the installation, it was completely hassle free - Very neat and tidy Job when finished and we couldn't be happier
Everything was perfect from start to go, Well donethan you

I highly recommend the team from Solargain Gippsland.  From coming to the house to see what was needed for the installation before the quote was prepared  to the time the Installation team left.Out of the 3 companies that I contacted they were the only one that came to the house to see what was needed to do an install before the quote was prepared.  The other two only worked off Google maps.The Operations Manager, Ben came and inspected the property, listened to what we wanted and where we wanted to place panels and sent us several quotes to work off until we got what we were happy with.Wait time for the install was acceptable after paying the deposit and Jamie and his team arrived on the week that was scheduled.   They were very professional and had the old system removed and the new one installed in a day & a half.I was very impressed on how well they all worked as a team.Everything about the Inverter App was explained and worked through with me, as well as the Catch Relay App for the Hot water. Everyone was friendly and helpful and took time to explain anything you asked.I would recommend Solargain to anyone that is looking at getting a Solar System installed.
Quoting service was great & Ben was available for any questions. Installation went smoothly. Grid connection took 2 weeks and all is well.Would recommend Solargain Bairnsdale to others.

Solargain Bairnsdale have been great to work with all Local workers in their Team. They were efficient and very neat - had no problems with achieving the Solar Inspection and receiving the compliance certificate. They used high quality racking and installed the panels in an order we requested to keep them as cool as possible by leaving a gap between each array.We will be buying our battery system from them in a couple of years - can recommend Solargain Bairnsdale to anyone.We are now self sufficient with solar and backup generator. We didn't need to install a solar hot water service - we have 13.2kW of solar power which heats out resistive Rinnai 315 hot water system during the day through switching installed by Solargain Bairnsdale. We also have a 7kVa Honda Inverter Generator which is now hard wired into our switchboard by Solargain Bairnsdale. There price was more than competitive with other installers - but their happy work ethics was a pleasure to watch.

Solargain Gippsland were very helpful and punctual. Ben came out to my property and answered all my questions in regard to placement and limitations of panels and hardware. He also organised a new hot water service at the same time.Work went quickly and no mess left. Very clean. Only thing I didn't get was the phone app to check the power usage/generated.

I had a fantastic experience with SolarGain Gippsland. The sales and quoting process was straightforward and informative, making it easy to understand my options. Ash in customer service was incredibly helpful throughout the entire process. The installation crew was not only polite and punctual but also did a great job cleaning up after themselves. They even assisted with organising the grid connection and showed me how to use the charger. Overall, I couldn't be happier with the service!

From the initial enquiry, through installation and follow up completion Solargain Gippsland were prompt, friendly, efficient and very easy to deal with. I would recommend them to anyone consider installing a solar energy system or heat pump. In one word - excellent!

We recently had a PV system installed by Solargain Gippsland, and we couldn't be happier with the results. Ben was fantastic to deal with from start to finish, helping us design a system that perfectly suited our needs. The team used high-quality Fronius equipment, and the install team was professional, efficient, and left everything neat and tidy. Highly recommend Solargain Gippsland for anyone looking to invest in solar – they made the whole process smooth and hassle-free!

Quoting service was easy and understandable for the lay person, the installation was done in one day and they were polite and tidy. The customer service was excellent, we did not have to do much at all, it was taken care of for us. From the start of installation to now waiting on our service provider to finalise their part has only taken one week. Very impressed.

From the quoting process onwards the team at Solargain were fantastic. They answered all the questions that I had. The install team were great and very friendly, explaining  all the functions of the inverter  and battery. We are still to have our system commissioned as yet.

Professional, helpful and fantastic to deal with from start to finishHelped through the rebate process and kept me informed along the wayInstallation was done in a professional and timely mannerHighly recommended for your solar needs

Quote received same day as visit. Sales Person got onto roof for inspection rather than rely on Google picture of roof. Installation date was set and crew arrived on time. Gave an overview of the process, kept us informed of the timelines, cleaned up and demonstrated the inverter shut down start up procedure, and the smart meter.

Quoting process excellentOffice people excellentGreat installation polite, tidy, punctual and organized grid connection but never got back to me with a problem I had in that when I bought the house the previous owner had the old system wired to only use solar excess on the hot water like a diverter does and now they've added the extra system the hot water comes on ANYTIME even on the dearest rate!I've ordered a green catch diverter and in the meantime been manually switching the hot water on at 10 am
I decided on solargain even though they were not the cheapest.They inspired confidence by demonstrating their expertise and understanding of my needs.

The experience with Solargain from initial contact seeking advice on a suitable system through quoting to installation and grid connection has been without question a trouble free process made easier with their attention to detail.
Impressed by the dedicated installers and the quality of their work.
They are a great company to deal with and have used them before.
Quoting process was great, simple to understandInstallation was very punctual and without any dramasCustomer service was great, plenty of communication
A quick response to my query re installation of a solar system. Paperwork was made simple with help from Jacqui in the office.   Install went seamlessly.  Highly recommend Solargain Gippsland

Both sales and quoting where excellent, they were very helpful, answering all our questions and concerns. We also went for a new hot water system connected to the unit. I would have no problem recommending Solargain. System is not yet installed due to current work load.

Great team preparation, installation, consultation, communication and all follow up needs have been met. Very little for me to do ! Good job, highly recommended.

SolarGain was initially referred to us through Solar Quotes and accepting their quote was easy to make due to their professionalism and great customer service.  Jacqui at SolarGain Gippsland was so easy to deal with and took us through every step when making the application for our rebate from Vic Solar.  Jeremy, the installer/electrician was also very obliging and friendly and explained everything we needed to know about our solar installation.   I would definitely recommend SolarGain Gippsland and will be returning to them when we are ready to install a battery to our system.

I contacted Solargain Bairnsdale after unsuccessful attempts to obtain a quote from another local solar installer.Jacqui arranged for Matt to come out the next morning.  Matt discussed our requirements, designed the system and had our quote completed on the spot.  We accepted the quote and the system was installed 6 weeks later.Daniel and his installation team were very professional, explained how the system works and the process involved in connecting to the grid.  Jacqui was vey helpful and knowledgeable in answering any questions I had during the process.I would highly recommend Solargain Bairnsdale to anyone in the region looking to install solar.
Crew arrived on time and worked as a team to get the job done in fairly windy conditions. Whole crew were very friendly. A very tidy install and I'm pleased with the result.

Considering that there is no other installer available in my area they are one of the most professional company that I’ve dealt with. They turned up when they said they would and every time I had a question they got back to me straight away. I would have no hesitation in recommending the whole company

From the initial quote and explanation to someone who had little knowledge of solar, to the installation team, all went exactly as per plan.Every time I had another question it was answered.Solargain arranged for the grid connection and connection with power retailer.

6.6kw Installation and commission proceeded as planned.I already had a 5kw Sungrow storage system in place and was limited for space in my switchboard.By going with another Sungrow inverter I was able to leverage off my existing consumption smart meter and integrate into my existing phone based app.Ben the system designer allowed for an additional break out box as a Plan B if the integration to the one meter was not successful.The installation team were very efficient and left every thing in a very clean and tidy state.Solargain arranged for the Electrical Inspection and my new system is now up and running.As I had previously accessed the Victorian Solar Program I was not entitled to any rebates beyond the STCs.I did pursue five other quotes  some which were circa $3k cheaper, however I decided to  stick with the local supplier that I knew had been in business for a while.

Matt came out to see us and was extremely knowledgeable and great to deal withJacqui followed up on everything and was so outstanding, Jacqui let nothing undone - great will all communication.Daniel and his team installed the panels on a warm day, they were a credit to young people so respectful.Fabulous experience from start to finish - thank you so much.

Everything went extremely smoothly and efficiently right from the quotation step, through to receiving all pre-installation paperwork and payment steps, meeting the specified date of installation, the exceptional quality of work and professionalism of the installation team, to the final series of essential paperwork steps as previously advised in detail.  Highly recommended.

Everything was amazing, from the first day of quotes to the final end result.I was quoted back in October and the install finished early Feb.The experience is honestly a full 20/20 stars but I have to do 4/5 for value only because I myself didn't look around more to know if the price I paid for the system was good value or not. My friends and family in other states and areas told me what they paid for their and I wondered if I had done more looking maybe!But no regrets going with solargain, I can highly recommend themThanks again!

All communication was timely. Our requirements were taken note of and the company was prepared to make some adjustments to panel angles part way through installation at our request. Installers were on time, courteous and tidied up each day of the three day installation. The company supported us in organising the grid connection. The system was clearly explained to us.We chose this company  because of the high standard of service at the sales/quotation stage. The company representation took the time to listen to our requirements and discuss possibilities. His knowledge of the product and the industry in general was very apparent. This company was also the only one recommended by SolarQuotes in our area and although we spoke to two other companies, Solargain was the obvious choice for us and their quote was competitive.

Our experience with Solargain Gippsland was extremely positive. From Ben at the quoting stage to the communication with the rebates and the installation we could not fault. The team were very polite, tidy and professional in every aspect of our dealing with the company, and Jeremy was very patient with the handover and app explanation.
Extremely satisfied with the entire process with Solargain, They provided a very trustworthy, professional service and a high quality product.

A very satisfactory experience from the initial discussions and quote right through to installation and administration.The team were knowledgeable, safety conscious and polite.Communication between all parties was excellent.The system was operating in a very short time following completion.Great job.Thanks Solargain Gippsland.

Solargain Gippsland's service was excellent, they installed the solar panels, inverter and battery with no problems, and at all times the team worked safely and efficiently. I would recommend this company to anyone who wishes to have solar panels etc installed on their property.
Great service very informative and helpful, quick installation very professional. Wonderful

The team arrived early and had the job done with no fuss.Excellent customer service. Really happy we went with Solargrain.

From the very first visit by Ben to discuss our options, the quote then require delivered, the installation by Daniel and his team and the support from Matt and the Bairnsdale office we have had a positive, seamless process from start to finish with our new solar system.  They supported us to  navigate through the government rebate process and have answered our questions clearly and efficiently along the way.

Highly recommend Solargain Gippsland. Great communication throughout the whole process, from receiving quotes until the panels were installed. The staff were all helpful & friendly. The team arrived on time & did an amazing job.
Easy to deal with, no sales pressure, change quote to maximise system size for my needs, good technical knowledge, trouble free instal.  System installed after 2022 and has performed well.

Very happy with the whole process with Solargain Gippsland. The rep was knowledgeable, polite and professional. The installation crew were equally as professional and competent and the office staff were a pleasure to deal with.  This was a painless experience from start to finish. I'd be happy to recommend this company to anyone.Jim Scott.

I really appreciate a company that is on time, and they were. When I had a query, it was answered quickly. The installation looks very good and everything works perfectly. The sales and quoting process was easy to understand and informative. Installation of system was excellent with a friendly crew who were professional and installed in a timely manner. We are very happy with our choice of installer.

Bryn was an excellent communicator and worked with me to achieve my goals and the system components I requested.Would recommend this company to everyone.

Great service from all involved from start to finish. Bryn was fantastic to deal with and nothing was to much trouble and answered all questions and queries very promptly. The sales/quoting process exceeded my expectations. We chose Solargain Gippsland because they did a site visit and I was able to meet the person who would be supporting us through this installation. They were not the cheapest of the quotes that we received, but we felt very confident in the advice that was given and that they were genuine in helping us choose well.The installation was amazing! A crew of about eight people arrived when they said they would  and were clearly ready to work safely and efficiently to complete the work within a day. I was really pleased that I did not detect any cigarettes (either from the smell of smoke, or butts on the ground) - my assumption is that none of the workers were smokers but if they were, they were extremely discreet.The Team Leader kept me informed of progress and when the power needed to be turned off. The Team Leader was patient with me to make sure I was comfortable with the decisions that were being made about the position of the PV panels before continuing with the work. The team were very mindful of taking care with the fragile roof tiles when breakages are common. I was really happy that only one tile was broken when I was preparing for there to be many more.The customer service throughout the process and afterwards has been the best I have ever seen! It gave me great comfort to be able to email or call Solargain Gippsland and speak directly to my contact there. I have been informed of all the steps along the way and feel that I have made a really good decision to work with this company.
